node.label: Abnormality of the sphenoid sinus
node.definition: An abnormality of the sphenoid sinus, one of the mucosa-lined, normally air-filled paranasal sinuses of the bones of the skull. The sphenoid sinus is located within the sphenoid bone.

evidence.snippet: Alpha-mannosidosis, infantile form: Abnormality of the sphenoid sinus (frequency HP:0040283) [TAS]
Abnormality of the sphenoid sinus — Occasional (29-5%)
